اعتمرتما (form VIII)
# اِعْتَمَرْتُمَا (iʕtamartumā) /iʕ.ta.mar.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of اِعْتَمَرَ (iʕtamara)
# اُعْتُمِرْتُمَا (uʕtumirtumā) /uʕ.tu.mir.tu.maː/: second-person dual past passive of اِعْتَمَرَ (iʕtamara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
